4
X and Y are atoms.
●
X and Y have the same number of electron shells.
●
X and Y have the same number of outer electrons.
●
X and Y have different mass numbers.
Which statements about X and Y are correct?
1
X and Y are isotopes.
2
X and Y have the same total number of electrons.
3
X and Y have the same chemical properties.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
